title: FEED THE SICKNESS expresses true emotions with debut single “SCREAM”
htmlContent:
"Scream," Feed The Sickness's debut single, is an intense experience that dives deep into emotions. Anger and skill come together in a powerful wave of sound. Feed The Sickness has not only drawn inspiration from the band KoRn but also brought their own wild style.

The vocals are filled with raw feelings, sometimes angry, sometimes hauntingly beautiful. They express frustration and sadness that can only be released through music, making every line feel like a powerful outpouring of emotion. The guitar riffs twist and turn unexpectedly, the drums alternate between strong pounding and surprising beats, and the bass sounds like a brewing storm.

https://open.spotify.com/album/7pCBSF6o7f6juE6qeJUogh?si=iOjIbEKBSDyVTOKhWc-mdw

When you think you know what's coming next, the song shifts direction, keeping listeners engaged and filled with excitement. It's a debut that introduces Feed The Sickness and grabs your attention. Feed The Sickness isn't just creating music, they're making a bold statement.
